signin.title: Sign in
signin.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a sign-in code. New here? The same step creates your account.
signin.code_intro: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. If it is not there in a minute, look in your junk or spam folder.
signin.newest: Only the newest email works. If you asked for more than one, use the last one.
setup.title: Set up your account
setup.intro: Add the name clients will recognize. You can change this later in Settings.
firm.name: Your name or business name
firm.name_hint: Clients see this on every request.
firm.legal_hint: If it differs from the name above.
firm.tz_hint: Reminders go out between 9:00 and 19:00 in this time zone.
firm.owner_only: Only the owner of the account can change these details.
settings.title: Settings
settings.plan_trial: Free trial ends on {date}. Subscribe any time; the first payment is when the trial ends.
settings.plan_trial_subscribed: Free trial ends on {date}. Your subscription starts then, at C$39 a month.
settings.plan_active: Subscribed, C$39 a month. Next payment on {date}.
settings.plan_cancelling: Subscribed until {date}. It will not renew.
settings.plan_past_due: Your last payment did not go through. Update your payment details by {date} to keep your account working.
settings.plan_ended: Your plan has ended. New links and deadline changes are paused. Everything you already have stays available.
settings.plan_owner: Only the owner of the account can change the plan.
settings.confirming_slow: Your payment is taking a moment to show up. Reload this page in a minute.
settings.close_hint: Closing signs everyone out, stops client links and reminders and ends the subscription. Everything in the account is deleted 30 days later, except records on legal hold. Until then you can sign in and reopen it.
settings.close_body: Type the account name to confirm: {name}
closed.title: This account is closed
closed.body: Its records are deleted on {date}. Until then you can reopen it. The subscription ended when the account was closed, so you will need to subscribe again.
closed.body_held: Its records were deleted on {date}, except those on legal hold. Because some are still held, you can still reopen the account. The subscription ended when it was closed, so you will need to subscribe again.
closed.member: Ask the owner of the account to reopen it.
settings.retention_hint: Finished requests and their files are deleted this long after they are closed, expire or are completed, unless they are on legal hold.
settings.retention_owner: Only the owner of the account can change this.
settings.retention_confirm_body_one: {n} finished request is already older than {years} years. It will move to Recently deleted and be removed for good after 30 days.
settings.retention_confirm_body_other: {n} finished requests are already older than {years} years. They will move to Recently deleted and be removed for good after 30 days.
requests.title: Requests
requests.empty_body: Send a client a checklist of documents with a deadline. Start with New request.
new.title: New request
new.no_clients: You have no clients yet. Add one to continue.
new.note_hint: Optional. The client sees this above the checklist.
items.label: Document
detail.link_none: No link yet. Create one to share the checklist with your client.
detail.link_exists: A link has been created. For safety it cannot be shown again. Make a new one if you need it.
detail.link_once: Copy this link now. It is shown only once.
detail.email_address: Add your mailing address in Settings to email clients.
detail.email_client: Add an email address for this client, with your confirmation that you may contact them, to email them.
detail.email_stopped: This client has asked not to get emails. Copy the link and send it yourself.
detail.emailed: Emailed to {email}. If they can't find it, ask them to look in their junk or spam folder.
detail.email_failed: The email could not be sent. Copy the link instead.
detail.reminders_on: Remind the client by email until the deadline
detail.new_link_warning: The link you shared before will stop working. Your client will need the new one.
detail.close_body: The client link stops working and the request can no longer be changed.
detail.refresh_failed: We could not refresh this page, so it may be out of date.
detail.reject_hint: The client sees this note next to the document.
detail.delete_body: The request disappears from your list and its client link stops working.

clients.name: Name
clients.permission: I have this client's permission to contact them by email or text.
clients.empty_body: Add a client here, or while creating a request.
clients.delete_body: Their open requests will be closed and their links will stop working.
templates.title: Templates
templates.name: Template name
templates.none: You have not made any templates yet. Copy a built-in one to start.
templates.delete_body: Requests already made from it are not affected.
client.gone: This link has expired or was replaced. Ask the person who sent it for a new link.
client.error: We could not load this page. Try again in a moment.
client.optional: Only if they apply to you
client.refresh_failed: We could not refresh this page, so it may be out of date.
client.privacy: Your files go only to {firm} and are stored encrypted.
detail.hold_help: Nothing on a request on legal hold is deleted, and the request cannot be deleted.
trash.title: Recently deleted
trash.intro: Deleted requests and clients can be restored for 30 days, then they are removed for good along with their files.
trash.empty: Nothing was deleted in the last 30 days.
trash.restored_request: Restored. It stays closed and cannot get a new link.
trash.restored_client: Restored. Their requests stay closed and their links stay off.

activity.intro: Everything done in this account, newest first.
activity.action.request.hold: Put a request on legal hold
activity.action.request.retention_delete: Moved to Recently deleted, retention period ended
activity.action.export: Downloaded all files as a zip
activity.action.retention.update: Changed how long records are kept
